This directory vendors the unmodified nv21_green and experimental luma_ellipse
detector sources and headers from DartVision2027 commit
f9eada7d7f732de6da797b68acb6e42b7fa3b054. The Android JNI adapter lives outside
vendor/. Update these files together; offline results may otherwise differ.
luma_ellipse is for local analysis only and does not change the board protocol.
